question: Is a blank line 3(a) a true zero? For the 55 blank-filed FY2023 IPS sponsors whose roll-forward (prior assets + line 2(a) - line 4(a)) implies an outflow above 10% of prior assets, read Schedule I, Part IX line 1, Schedule D Part XIII and Schedule O for DAF grant amounts or explanations; start with the largest (Foundation for Advanced Philanthropy, $132.4m DAF assets; Catholic Foundation of Greater Philadelphia, $30.1m)
conclusion_affected: Whether excluding blank-filed sponsors (IPS) or counting them at 0% (bridge counterfactual, 7.72%) is closer to the truth; the 7.7%-9.7% range for the FY2023 median sponsor
rationale: Blank is not evidence of zero: 127 of 197 blank-filed sponsors with prior-year assets show a roll-forward outflow <= 0 (compatible with no grants), but 55 show an outflow above 10% of prior assets, which grants could explain. Counting all blanks at 0% moves the median by -1.95 points, so the truth for this group matters
